[Thinking]
**Compiling Furniture Data**

I'm currently focusing on identifying and categorizing prominent office furniture brands. My current effort involves listing industry giants, mid-range providers, and specialized niche companies, ensuring I include their respective web addresses for easy access.

**Categorizing Furniture Providers**

My current focus is on refining the classification of furniture suppliers, moving from broad categories to more specific sub-groups. I'm differentiating between established contract leaders, popular direct-to-consumer brands, and specialized ergonomic specialists to ensure a comprehensive overview.
[/Thinking]

To help you find the right office furniture, I have categorized the top brands by their specialty, ranging from industry giants and ergonomic specialists to modern direct-to-consumer brands.

### 1. The "Big Four" (Industry Leaders)
These brands are the gold standard for corporate environments, known for high-end engineering, long warranties, and sustainable manufacturing.
*   **Herman Miller:** [hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com) (Famous for the Aeron and Embody chairs)
*   **Steelcase:** [steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com) (Known for the Gesture and Leap chairs)
*   **Knoll:** [knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com) (Focuses heavily on modern design/Bauhaus style; now part of MillerKnoll)
*   **Haworth:** [haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com) (High-performance seating and specialized workspace solutions)

### 2. Modern & Direct-to-Consumer (D2C)
These brands are popular for startups and home offices because they offer modern aesthetics at a lower price point than the legacy brands above.
*   **Branch:** [branchfurniture.com](https://www.branchfurniture.com) (High-quality, easy-to-assemble office furniture for businesses and individuals)
*   **Poppin:** [poppin.com](https://www.poppin.com) (Colorful, modern designs and "work from home" kits)
*   **Fully:** [fully.com](https://www.fully.com) (Now integrated into Herman Miller, but known for the Jarvis standing desk)
*   **Article:** [article.com](https://www.article.com) (Mid-century modern style desks and chairs)

### 3. Ergonomic Specialists
If you are looking for furniture specifically designed to prevent back pain and improve posture:
*   **Humanscale:** [humanscale.com](https://www.humanscale.com) (Minimalist, high-end ergonomic tools and seating)
*   **Uplift Desk:** [upliftdesk.com](https://www.upliftdesk.com) (The current leader in customizable standing desks)
*   **Vari (formerly Varidesk):** [vari.com](https://www.vari.com) (Known for desk converters and quick-setup office furniture)
*   **Autonomous:** [autonomous.ai](https://www.autonomous.ai) (Budget-friendly ergonomic chairs and smart desks)

### 4. Value & Practical Commercial Brands
These brands offer "contract-grade" furniture (built to last 8+ hours of daily use) but at a more affordable price than Herman Miller or Steelcase.
*   **HON:** [hon.com](https://www.hon.com) (The industry standard for reliable, mid-priced office furniture)
*   **Global Furniture Group:** [globalfurnituregroup.com](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com) (Large range of professional office and healthcare furniture)
*   **National Business Furniture:** [nbf.com](https://www.nbf.com) (A massive distributor of many different brands)

### 5. High-End Design & European Style
For offices where the aesthetic is as important as the functionality:
*   **Vitra:** [vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com) (Iconic European designer furniture)
*   **Hay:** [hay.dk](https://hay.dk) (Contemporary Danish design)
*   **Arper:** [arper.com](https://www.arper.com) (Sleek, Italian-designed chairs and tables)
*   **Muuto:** [muuto.com](https://www.muuto.com) (Scandinavian design for modern workspaces)

### 6. Retailers (Multi-brand Stores)
If you want to compare multiple brands in one place:
*   **Design Within Reach (DWR):** [dwr.com](https://www.dwr.com) (The retail face of MillerKnoll and other high-end designers)
*   **West Elm Work:** [westelmwork.com](https://www.westelmwork.com) (The commercial line of West Elm)
*   **Amazon (Workplace):** [amazon.com](https://www.amazon.com/b?node=1064954) (Best for budget brands like Flash Furniture or Lorell)

### Tips for Buying:
*   **Warranty:** High-end brands like Steelcase and Herman Miller usually offer **12-year warranties**. Budget brands usually offer 1–3 years.
*   **Lead Times:** Many contract furniture brands (Haworth, Knoll) can take 4–8 weeks for delivery unless they have a "Quick Ship" section.
*   **Used/Refurbished:** Because many of these brands are expensive, many people buy them refurbished from sites like **Madison Seating** or **BTOD**.
